apple_pie.title: Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).

Prepare pie crust: Mix flour and salt. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add ice water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until dough forms. Divide in half, shape into disks, and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Peel, core, and slice apples.
In a large bowl, mix apples, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, flour, and lemon juice.
Roll out one disk of dough and fit into a 9-inch pie plate. Fill with apple mixture.
Roll out the second disk of dough and place over apples. Trim, seal, and flute edges. Cut slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbly.
Cool on a wire rack before serving.

baby_back_ribs.title: Baby Back Ribs
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Season the ribs with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Grill ribs for 20 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush ribs with BBQ sauce and grill for another 10 minutes.
Serve with additional BBQ sauce.

baklava.title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Layer phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing with butter between layers.
Mix walnuts with sugar and cinnamon, and sprinkle between layers of dough.
Bake for 45 minutes.
In a saucepan, combine honey and water, bring to a boil, and pour over baked baklava.
Let it cool before serving.

beef_carpaccio.title: Beef Carpaccio
instructions: Freeze beef for 1 hour.
Slice beef thinly.
Arrange beef slices on a plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Top with arugula and shaved Parmesan.
Season with salt and pepper.

beef_tartare.title: Beef Tartare
instructions: Chop beef finely.
Mix beef with capers, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, egg yolk, shallots, salt, and pepper.
Shape into a patty and serve with toast or crackers.
Garnish with chopped parsley.

beet_salad.title: Beet Salad
instructions: Boil or roast beets until tender, then slice.
Toss beets with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Top with crumbled goat cheese and walnuts.
Season with salt and pepper.

beignets.title: Beignets
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Add milk and stir to form a dough.
Heat oil in a deep fryer to 375°F (190°C).
Drop spoonfuls of dough into hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.

bibimbap.title: Bibimbap
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Sauté carrots, spinach, and bean sprouts separately.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Serve rice in bowls, topped with vegetables and eggs.
Add a dollop of gochujang sauce and mix well before eating.

bread_pudding.title: Bread Pudding
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Place bread cubes in a baking dish.
In a bowl, mix together milk, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, and cinnamon.
Pour mixture over bread cubes and let soak for 30 minutes.
Bake for 45 minutes until set and golden brown.
Serve warm or cold.

breakfast_burrito.title: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Scramble eggs in a skillet.
Warm tortillas in a microwave or skillet.
Fill tortillas with eggs, cheese, sausage, and salsa.
Fold and roll tortillas to form burritos.
Serve warm.

bruschetta.title: Bruschetta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet and brush both sides with olive oil.
Bake for 5-7 minutes or until golden brown and crisp.
In a bowl, combine diced tomatoes, basil, garlic, and remaining olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and add balsamic vinegar if desired.
Top each bread slice with the tomato mixture.
Serve immediately.

caesar_salad.title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Chop romaine lettuce.
Toss lettuce with croutons and Parmesan cheese.
Drizzle with Caesar dressing and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

cannoli.title: Cannoli
instructions: Mix ricotta cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Fill cannoli shells with the ricotta mixture.
Dust with additional powdered sugar before serving.

caprese_salad.title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella cheese.
Layer the tomato and mozzarella slices on a serving platter.
Tuck the fresh basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

carrot_cake.title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Add oil and eggs, mix well.
Stir in grated carrots.
Pour into a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Bake for 40-45 minutes.
Cool and frost as desired.

ceviche.title: Ceviche
instructions: Cut fish into small cubes.
Marinate fish in lime juice for 15 minutes.
Slice red onion thinly.
Chop chili pepper and cilantro.
Mix all ingredients and season with salt.
Serve chilled.

cheesecake.title: Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C).
Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press into a baking pan.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth.
Add eggs one at a time, then vanilla extract.
Pour over crust and bake for 50 minutes.
Cool and refrigerate before serving.

cheese_plate.title: Cheese Plate
instructions: Arrange the cheeses on a large platter.
Add assorted crackers around the cheeses.
Fill in the gaps with grapes and nuts.
Serve with a small bowl of honey for drizzling .

chicken_curry.title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger. Sauté until onions are translucent.
Add curry powder and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add chicken and cook until browned.
Pour in coconut milk and chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with rice.

chicken_quesadilla.title: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add diced bell pepper and onion. Sauté until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add shredded chicken, ground cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in chopped fresh cilantro.
Heat a separate skillet over medium heat.
Place one tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with a layer of shredded cheddar and Monterey Jack cheese.
Spread a portion of the chicken mixture over the cheese.
Top with another layer of shredded cheese and place a second tortilla on top.
Cook until the bottom tortilla is golden brown and the cheese is melted, about 2-3 minutes.
Carefully flip the quesadilla and cook until the other side is golden brown.
Remove from skillet and repeat with remaining tortillas and filling.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and serve warm.
